title: Olicity Cheese Cloths, 6PCS, Grade 100,20x20Inch Hemmed Cheese Cloth Fabric Reusable Fine Mesh Cloth, 100% Cotton Unbleached Precut Muslin Cheesecloth for Straining, Cooking, Yogurt, Juicing
description:
About this item
Made from 100% natural pure cotton, no odor, no lint, no chemicals, easy wash and reusable.
20x20Inch Pre-cut Suitable Size - No need to cut manually. Well Hemmed & No Shed Lint - Prevent small threads drop in the food. Easy Clean - Reused many times with a simple rinse.
SGS Tested Grade 100 - Our woven fabrics is 56x41. Didn't reduce threads. No Easy to Tear - The higher threads per square inch, the higher cost. You got what you pay.
Chemical Free - Strain broth, baste turkey, make jams and fruit jelly, all without chemicals. Unbleached Pure Cotton - Strain soy milk, cold brew coffee, juice, and any other foods without worrying.
Packed with vacuum sealed packaging to keep cheese cloths clean and fresh! Good for saving packaging materials and be beneficial to reducing carbon emission. You can strain the food with confidence.

reviews_1s:
At another attempt to use my cheese cloth and and two mesh bags at home to make some more kefir cheese, I cld not because it was not working for me, the cream would not hold so I decided to order this item as a hurry. Big mistake. I truly thought this would work bc of the reviews that it held the cream very well. There are black spots all over these bags!!! They come off when you scrape it with your nail!! Disgusting! It would ruin my cheeses!! I attempted to wash one, no way-the spots were sticking to the cloth and some spots would pull off. I'll read more reviews next time or just get it locally. This is not even worth returning but it's a must for a refund.Has anyone else taken time to read the info on the package before using? It states "Olicity cheesecloth is unbleached, YOU MAY FIND SOMETHING LIKE BLACK SPOTS ON IT WHEN YOU ARE READY TO USE IT. DON'T WORRY, THAT'S NOT DIRT. PLEASE BOIL IT WITH WATER IN A PAN AT LEAST 15 MINUTES!!!!!!!! If it's not dirt, then WHAT EXACTLY IS IT???? NO THANKS!!! Made me think twice about using this product! This is the problem when items come from China, you just don't know exactly what you are really getting!!!!!!!!These cloths has black spots all over them. I don’t trust this for my tinctures. Waist of money.The picture conveniently places the word HEMMED over the packaging that states: Please boil it in a pan with water for at least 15 min? Why? It says you may find something like black spots on it when you are ready to use it "But don't worry, that's not dirt". Why would i need to boil it and what are the black spots?
Sorry not going to risk it!They are super sticky for cheese, I can not get them to not stock to the cheese like glue, u have to use a dough scraper to get the cheese off of them, and you can imagine the ugly cheese that results from rinds all torn off. They shouldn't label them for cheese when they are this sticky. Cheese whey is a sticky substance in goat milk and whenever I use one of these cloth, it ruins the cheese and I have to throw the cloth away tooThis is a really low quality Cheesecloth, I have tried everything to get rid of the tiny brown bits and seeds in this cheesecloth. it's completely infested with it, I have tried boiling it, soaking it in vinegar or baking soda and then washing it. Nothing removes the brown bits at all except if you do it manually by hand but it'll take you years since they are everywhere.

Do your self a favor and buy a better quality cheesecloth.Quality is poor.Came with small dark spots, and a disclaimer on the package that the spots aren't dirt. Great, so what are they?

Pkg said to boil for 15 minutes - ok, seems like the spots might be dangerous. So I did that, then washed with a bit of bleach. After the starch is out, it seems like 20% of the fabric was just the starch. Not sure if I care to use them now.BADThe product description is misleading. It's NOT hemmed.
